title: reconcile.conflict.recorded
description: An edge reconciliation conflict was detected and escalated. Conflicts are first-class, queryable records rather than only audit-ledger entries, because a conflict that is only visible in a ledger is a conflict nobody triages. Required by ADR-0006 Step 6.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate whose reconciliation could not be decided automatically.

conflictClass.description: The class of conflict. Each class routes to a different escalation path (ADR-0006 Step 6).

resolution.description: What the platform did about it.

winningEventId.description: The event that won, where a deterministic winner existed.

losingEventId.description: The event that lost, where a deterministic winner existed.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the conflict could not be resolved automatically.

escalationTask.description: The task raised for a human to resolve the conflict.

assignedTo.description: The role that owns the escalation.
